name: loadsketch
description: System design simulator: sketch an architecture, send traffic through it, and see what breaks first.
author: Minchen Lee

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.test:quick: vitest run --exclude tests/format.test.ts --exclude tests/learn.test.ts --exclude tests/timescale.test.ts --exclude tests/constraints.test.ts --exclude tests/briefs.test.ts --exclude tests/components.test.ts --exclude tests/oncall.test.ts --exclude tests/queueing.test.ts --exclude tests/golden.test.ts --exclude tests/import/limit.test.ts && node scripts/i18n-extract.ts --check
scripts.test:slow: vitest run tests/format.test.ts tests/learn.test.ts tests/timescale.test.ts tests/constraints.test.ts tests/briefs.test.ts tests/components.test.ts tests/oncall.test.ts tests/queueing.test.ts tests/golden.test.ts tests/import/limit.test.ts
